sources.name: arXiv API query: cs.AI and cs.CY, newest submissions
sources.reason: robots.txt for export.arxiv.org could not be fetched from the build environment (outbound egress blocked), so the robots status is unverified. Operator: run `pdoom-ingest --check-robots --allow-network`, confirm the arXiv API Terms of Use (https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/tou.html: at most one request every 3 seconds, single connection) and then set robots_status, robots_checked_at and allowed: true.
sources.license: arXiv API Terms of Use; arXiv metadata is CC0 1.0; full text carries a per-article licence
sources.notes: Atom response. Politeness: SafeClient enforces a 3-second per-host minimum delay, which satisfies the arXiv rule. Preprints are not peer reviewed: tier 2 at most; per-item tier is set at human review.

sources.name: METR research and evaluation posts
sources.reason: Feed URL, site terms and robots.txt are unverified: metr.org could not be reached from the build environment (egress blocked). Operator: confirm the feed exists at this URL, record the licence stated on the site, run the robots check, then enable.
sources.notes: Independent evaluation organisation; evaluation reports are primary sources for D1 capability and D2 autonomy signals (for example task-horizon measurements).

sources.name: Epoch AI research posts
sources.reason: Feed URL, licence and robots.txt are unverified: epoch.ai could not be reached from the build environment (egress blocked). Epoch AI publishes much of its data under CC BY 4.0; confirm that the feed content is covered, run the robots check, then enable.
sources.notes: Compute, data and hardware trend analyses feed D1 and D4 signals. Trend extrapolations are predictions and must be recorded with evidence_type forecast or expert_judgment.

sources.name: NIST news releases
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.reason: robots.txt for www.nist.gov could not be fetched from the build environment (egress blocked); the feed URL is also unverified. Operator: run the robots check, confirm the feed, then enable.

sources.notes: Covers the AI Risk Management Framework, the Center for AI Standards and Innovation and evaluation announcements. Most items are off-topic; reviewers keep only AI governance and evaluation items (D5, D7).

sources.name: UK AI Security Institute publications (GOV.UK organisation feed)

sources.reason: Feed URL and robots.txt are unverified: www.gov.uk could not be reached from the build environment (egress blocked). GOV.UK content is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0 unless stated otherwise; confirm the organisation slug and robots status, then enable.

sources.notes: Government evaluation and research publications; jurisdiction UK. Signals D5 alignment_control and D7 governance.

sources.name: OECD.AI Policy Observatory updates
sources.reason: The feed URL is a candidate that could not be verified (oecd.ai unreachable from the build environment) and OECD terms and conditions govern reuse of OECD content. Operator: locate the official feed, record the applicable OECD licence terms, run the robots check, then enable.
sources.notes: Intergovernmental policy observatory; the AI Incidents Monitor (AIM) is a separate registry whose ids belong in incident.external_ids.oecd_aim.

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database (reviewed advisories)
sources.reason: The GitHub REST API permits unauthenticated programmatic access within rate limits, but robots.txt for api.github.com could not be fetched from the build environment (egress restricted to repository-scoped endpoints). Operator: run the robots check (record not_applicable if the API terms, not robots.txt, govern access), confirm that only category-level metadata is retained, then enable.
sources.notes: The json parser keeps advisory id, summary, severity, dates and URL only; exploit and remediation detail is never stored (content-safety rule). Aggregate counts inform D6 security signals; individual advisories are rarely relevant.

sources.name: AI Incident Database snapshots
sources.reason: Manual dataset source, never crawled: incidents are imported by hand from the published database snapshot under CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike apply to derived records). robots.txt was not checked because no automated fetch is planned.
sources.notes: Keep the AIID incident id in incident.external_ids.aiid. Summaries must be non-graphic and non-operational (build-spec rule 0.9).

sources.name: Metaculus questions API (AI topics)
sources.reason: Metaculus Terms of Use restrict automated collection and the endpoint shape and robots status could not be verified from the build environment. Forecasts are entered manually with the original question wording and resolution criteria; enable only with written permission from Metaculus.
sources.notes: source_type forecast_platform; population public_forecasters. Community predictions must keep their outcome definition, horizon and resolution criteria (build-spec rules 0.4 and 0.5).
